name: large-repository
description: 100 GiB-class multi-shard repository capacity profile; complete AV and per-file limits remain mandatory
notes: One API and one staging owner only.
Source LFS and sealed staging are two complete physical copies, budgeted at 220 GiB for a 110 GiB task.
The 120 GiB staging quota includes retained immutable snapshots; the 5 GiB batch cap is not a total staging peak.
The free-space preflight requires 220 GiB for source+sealed copies plus 70 GiB reserve. Public input downloads and existing data consume additional space.
Compressed members retain the 128 MiB expansion cap; large compressed models may fail closed.
No 100 GiB single-file support is claimed. Every file is bounded at 1280 MiB and must complete AV and integrity checks.
Run this 8 GiB scanner profile separately from the 8 GiB acceptance VM on the current host.
